scripts.postpublish: echo "🎉 Published successfully! You can now publish the vscode extension seperately by running 'cd packages/vscode-lit-plugin && pnpm run publish'"
scripts.publish:next: pnpm -r publish --tag next && pnpm run postpublish
scripts.test:headless: pnpm --filter ./packages/lit-analyzer run test && pnpm --filter ./packages/lit-language-server run test && pnpm --filter ./packages/ts-simple-type run test && pnpm --filter ./packages/web-component-analyzer run test
scripts.test:headful: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter ./packages/vscode-lit-plugin run test
scripts.test: pnpm run test:headless && pnpm run test:headful && pnpm run lint
scripts.package: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter ./packages/vscode-lit-plugin run package
